items.title: 'GTA VI' pre-sales hit $1 billion ahead of Nov. 19 launch
items.summary: Al Root, Barron's Associate Editor, joins the 8:30 hosts, Julie Hyman and Pras Subramanian, to discuss preorder sales of "Grand Theft VI" (TTWO) reportedly topping $1 billion ahead of its Nov. 19 release date.

items.title: Jefferies names top internet stocks to own through 2027
items.summary: Investing.com -- Jefferies has identified three internet stocks as top picks heading into 2027, highlighting AppLovin, Take-Two Interactive, and Spotify as names positioned for significant upside based on new product launches, improving unit economics, and attractive valuations.

items.title: GTA VI Comes Out Thursday. She Bought 588 Take-Two Shares the Day GTA V Launched. They’re Worth $131,994
items.summary: A grandmother who bought 588 Take-Two shares at $17.00 on Grand Theft Auto V's launch day in 2013 holds $131,994 as GTA VI arrives Nov. 19. She can sell 187 shares at a 0% federal rate, sell everything for about $12,465 in tax, or give shares to her grandson.

items.title: Best 2027 stocks: Jefferies picks top 3 names to own next year
items.summary: Investing.com -- Jefferies has identified three favorite stock ideas for investors looking ahead to 2027, with AppLovin leading the list as the firm’s top pick, followed by Take-Two Interactive and Spotify.

items.title: Take-Two shares rise premarket as Jefferies sees strong GTA VI pre-orders
items.summary: Investing.com -- Take-Two Interactive Software Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO) shares rose 4% in premarket trading on Monday, after Jefferies said strong pre-orders for Grand Theft Auto VI are pushing expectations for the game’s unit sales toward the top of the 40 million to 50 million range, ahead of its launch on Thursday.

items.title: ‘Grand Theft Auto’ Maker’s Stock Gets Boost Ahead of New Release
items.summary: The calendar is packed with consequential events this week, but some will argue the most important date is Nov. 19, when "Grand Theft Auto VI" will finally be released.

items.title: 3 Gaming Stocks Offering Growth Amid Industry Headwinds
items.summary: Three gaming stocks - TTWO, RSI and ACEL - offer growth potential through strong franchises, digital expansion and rising player engagement despite industry headwinds.
